title: Grateful Dead Live at Poplar Creek Music Theatre on 1983-06-28
source: Robert Bryant recording: unknown mics > cassette master (sony wm-d6); Charlie Miller DSD Transfer: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz) > KORG AudioGate 4 > FLAC 24/96; Edited & Mastered in Audacity by Joe Noel: Wave > Flac 24/96; Checksum & tags created in xACT; 24 bit to 16 bit with MusicConverter using sox-14-4-2

ai_review.summary: Great audience recording of a high‑energy tour‑ender with fast tempos and solid performances throughout.
ai_review.review: The tape captures an exuberant show that closed the tour, featuring rapid tempos on every number and a massive setlist that delivers strong renditions across the board. Listeners note the sweet‑sounding tape quality despite it being an audience source, making the performance both lively and enjoyable to hear.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed review giving 4 stars; praise for both the energetic show and the pleasant tape sound suggests a solid performance with good recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a 'sweet‑sounding tape' with no noted flaws; overall clear enough to enjoy the fast‑tempo show.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Massive setlist performed at fast tempos, delivering consistent high energy and strong performances throughout the concert.
